state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress. These pages are written: "Start here", the Basics, "Values and types", Operators, Control flow and Errors.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/start-here.mdx`, `syntax/basics/*.mdx`, `syntax/values/*.mdx` (`arrays.mdx` now also covers spread and destructuring), `syntax/operators/*.mdx`, `syntax/control-flow/*.mdx` and `syntax/errors/{throw-and-catch,catch-expression,error-types,rethrowing,limits,assert-and-dump}.mdx`. Snippets sit flat under `website/snippets/syntax/<page>/`, with no section level, and must exit 0 when run from the repo root. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, and stamps are in `website/site.lock.json` (`bun nv site --stamp <page>...`). A front-matter value with `: ` in it must be quoted, or `covers:` reads as missing. A class id with backslashes goes in single quotes: `'Core\Db\DbError'`.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 57 uncovered features. These ids already have a planned page. `lang:types/callable-classes-object-shapes`, `lang:types/properties-and-constants`, `lang:expressions/object-literals`, `lang:expressions/is-new-clone-throw-print-exit-isset-empty`, `Comparable`, `Stringable`, `Parses` and `PropertyObserver` go to Classes. `lang:types/parameters`, `lang:types/void-never-self-static`, `lang:expressions/calls` and `lang:expressions/closures-fn` go to Functions. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `install/*`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stages 5 and 6 rewrite.

items.text: **Functions**: declaring, parameters and defaults, named arguments, `inout`, closures and callables, generics. A new sidebar group `syntax/functions/` after Errors. It covers `lang:types/parameters`, `lang:types/void-never-self-static`, `lang:expressions/calls` and `lang:expressions/closures-fn`. Goal § Stage 4. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/20-types.md:937`, `docs/reference/lang/20-types.md:329`, `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:465`, `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:550`, `website/astro.config.ts:178`

**Classes and objects**: classes, properties, methods, inheritance, interfaces, property hooks, `Stringable`, `Comparable`, `Parses`, `PropertyObserver`, object literals, `new` and `clone`. A new sidebar group `syntax/classes/`. It covers `lang:classes/*` and the ids listed in State. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/50-classes.md:1`, `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md:653`
**Programs and files**: namespaces and `use`, `require`, autoload, file paths, ending a program. It covers `lang:programs/*`. Anchors: `docs/reference/lang/10-programs.md:1`
